## Temporal structure and duration of actigraphy in ADHD prediction

*MSc thesis, 2026*

<!-- TODO: opening question inferred from the thesis title; reword to match what the thesis actually asked -->

How much accelerometry data do you need to predict ADHD, and does the way
activity is distributed across the day matter more than the total amount?
Using the Millennium Cohort Study (validated sample N = 5,033; more than 170
million data points), this project compares interpretable and complex machine
learning models, reports AUPRC alongside AUROC, examines calibration under low
outcome prevalence, and runs subgroup analyses to check for algorithmic bias.
Reported following TRIPOD+AI.
